correctness.rationale: For 0<b<1 both factors of det(I-K^2) are strictly positive, hence at most one strict quadrant-changing two-cycle. Direct branch equations construct it for exactly a<2b-1. The two-step matrix is K^2 with det(lambda I-K)=lambda^3+a^2 lambda-2ab. Its unique real root s has |s|<1; the conjugate roots have squared modulus a^2+s^2. Comparing the scalar cubic at sqrt(1-a^2) gives the exact boundary a^2(1+4b^2)=1. At the critical point K|W satisfies K^2+sK+I=0 and preserves H(xi,eta)=xi^2-s xi eta+eta^2, a strictly positive form, so small ellipses are exactly T^2-invariant. The rational verifier passed 320 parameter instances, plus a finite neutral diagnostic.

value.rationale: The two-cycle is a documented geometric organizing structure in the source sheet-attractor examples. The exact two-parameter stability boundary identifies a sink region and an index-two saddle region, excluding index-one saddles. At neutrality the locally affine return yields a continuum of exact invariant ellipses, a structurally important degeneracy qualitatively different from a generic isolated invariant circle. These are natural uncomputed local invariants, with no claims about global basins.
